title: Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.16546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target. We introduce GalerkinFlow, an equation-agnostic framework that turns each coarse--fine pair into supervision along an entire reconstruction path. At a random sample of intermediate states on the reconstruction path, the model predicts the coarse-to-fine residual velocity and uses coarse-anchor point to define a pseudo-endpoint. We show that the reconstruction loss of this pseudo-endpoint is exactly related to the intermediate velocity loss through a known time-dependent weight. Consequently, every intermediate state contributes supervision toward the same fine target, rather than serving only as an internal step toward an endpoint loss. translated_title: 监督通往精细尺度的路径：GalerkinFlow用于科学场和图像超分辨率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16546v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大多数超分辨率模型通过仅监督最终高分辨率输出来从配对数据中学习。这几乎无法控制预测在降采样观测与其精细目标之间应如何演变。我们引入了GalerkinFlow，一个与方程无关的框架，将每个粗-细配对转化为沿整个重建路径的监督。在重建路径上随机采样的中间状态处，模型预测粗到细的残差速度，并使用粗锚点定义伪端点。我们证明了该伪端点的重建损失与中间速度损失通过已知的时间依赖权重精确相关。因此，每个中间状态都为相同的精细目标贡献监督，而不仅仅作为朝向端点损失的内部步骤。由于中间状态已经揭示了部分缺失的精细尺度信息，这一方法增强了监督的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出GalerkinFlow框架，通过沿重建路径的中间状态监督来改进超分辨率，使每个粗-细配对提供全程指导，而非仅依赖最终输出。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GalerkinFlow, a framework that supervises intermediate states along the reconstruction path for super-resolution, enabling each coarse-fine pair to guide the entire evolution rather than just the final output.
